title: 720. Minimum ASCII Delete Sum for Two Strings

examples.explanation: Delete s from sea (115) and t from eat (116); the shared eat remains, costing 231.
Keep the shared leet and remove the extra d and extra e costs, totaling 403.
No character matches, so both letters are removed: 97 + 98.

hints: Think of the kept characters as a common subsequence; minimizing deletions equals maximizing kept ASCII sum.
Use a 2D table where cell (i,j) holds the cheapest cost for the two prefixes ending there.
When the current letters match, carry the diagonal value; otherwise drop the cheaper of the two single-side deletions.
